required.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
required.purpose: Answers, OCR (NVIDIA NIM). Get it at build.nvidia.com → your profile → API keys.

required.name: FIREBASE_ADMIN_PROJECT_ID
required.purpose: Where chats, accounts and uploaded books are stored (Firestore).

required.name: FIREBASE_ADMIN_PRIVATE_KEY
required.purpose: Firebase service account private key. Firebase console → Project settings → Service accounts → Generate new private key. Paste the whole key, with real line breaks or with \n.

required.name: FISH_AUDIO_API_KEY
required.purpose: BODHA's voice: read-aloud and Live Mode (Fish Audio).

required.name: GROQ_API_KEY
required.purpose: Dictation and Live Mode listening (Groq Whisper large v3 turbo).

recommended.name: AI_FIRST_BYTE_MS
recommended.purpose: How long the main model may stay silent before the next one takes over (default 6000; 9000 suits Kimi).

recommended.name: AI_THINKING
recommended.purpose: true/false — show-think models' reasoning mode. Keep false for speed.

recommended.name: AI_LIVE_MODEL
recommended.purpose: Fast model Live Mode asks first. Default z-ai/glm-5.3-flash.

recommended.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
recommended.purpose: Lets BODHA read GitHub reliably. Create a fine-grained token with read-only access to PUBLIC repositories only.
